verdict.rationale: Wise documents debit card issuance through its card-order APIs and physical card printing at kiosks, plus per-card spending permissions. However, this is framed as a platform API for issuing cards to a partner's customers, not as a Wise Business flow for issuing cards to employees, and nothing covers credit cards or role definitions. missing for 10: evidence of issuing cards to employees within a Wise Business account, defined employee roles/permissions tied to cardholders, credit card option, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can issue physical debit or credit cards to employees with defined roles

citations.quote: With this set of APIs, you will be able to create cards for your customers.
print and encrypt your card directly from a kiosk machine
Control spending permissions (e-commerce, ATM, contactless, magnetic stripe, etc.)
